business_intent: Which product category generated the highest total sales revenue?
sql:
SELECT
    category,
    total_sales
FROM sales_by_category_gold
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 1
narrative:
The analysis of the gold‑layer sales data shows that the **Beauty** product category generated the highest total sales revenue, amounting to **$26,541.85**. This figure surpasses the next best performer, Apparel, which recorded **$13,022.92** in sales, and is more than 15 times the revenue of the Clothing category, which contributed only **$1,473.13**.

The clear lead of the Beauty category indicates strong market demand and effective pricing or promotional strategies within this segment. Stakeholders should consider allocating additional marketing resources, inventory, and possibly expanding the product assortment in the Beauty category to capitalize on this momentum, while also investigating opportunities to boost performance in the lower‑selling categories.
